description: Locale configuration for Greek (el) in Moment.js, defining months, weekdays, relative time, calendar formats, and other locale-specific settings.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Returns the month name in nominative or genitive form based on the format and date.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns 'πμ' or 'μμ' depending on the hour, indicating AM or PM in Greek.

methods.name: isPM
methods.description: Determines if the input time is in the afternoon (PM).

methods.name: calendar
methods.description: Generates calendar strings with appropriate Greek prepositions based on the time and context.

methods.name: lastWeek
methods.description: Returns the string for last week, with different output for Saturday and other days.
